---
title: "Automation Configurations"
description: "Build enterprise-grade automation pipelines, operational workflows, and AI-native execution systems directly inside Revolte."
---

Revolte transforms automation from a fragmented DevOps responsibility into a fully integrated platform capability.

Instead of stitching together CI/CD pipelines, cron jobs, serverless functions, deployment scripts, and external orchestration tools, Revolte gives teams a unified **Automation Runtime** that executes workflows securely inside your application infrastructure.

From deployments and environment provisioning to operational tasks, data workflows, QA actions, migrations, and internal tooling—everything can be automated through a single AI-native interface.

<Frame caption="Create, manage, trigger, and monitor automation workflows directly inside Revolte.">
  <img src="/images/automation_configuration.png" alt="Automation configuration dashboard" width="600" />
</Frame>

## Why This Changes Everything

Traditional automation systems are difficult to maintain because they live outside the product ecosystem.

Revolte eliminates that separation.

Your workflows automatically understand:
- environments
- infrastructure boundaries
- permissions
- repositories
- runtime context
- deployment stages
- execution history

This enables teams to build operational workflows with the same simplicity as writing application logic.

# Enterprise Workflow Orchestration

Automation Configurations provide a centralized control plane for all operational workflows inside your platform.

These workflows are not limited to deployments.

You can automate:
- deployment orchestration
- environment setup
- infrastructure provisioning
- cache invalidation
- data migrations
- indexing jobs
- scheduled operations
- QA verification flows
- rollback procedures
- report generation
- repository maintenance
- operational recovery workflows

<Frame caption="View all configured workflows, execution states, durations, and statuses from a centralized dashboard.">
  <img src="/images/work-flows.png" alt="Workflow runs dashboard" width="600" />
</Frame>

## Intelligent Environment Awareness

Every workflow automatically understands where it is executing.

Whether triggered against:
- Preview
- Development
- Staging
- Production

Revolte injects the appropriate runtime context automatically.

This eliminates a major class of operational failures caused by incorrect environment targeting.

<CardGroup cols={3}>
  <Card title="Environment Scoped" icon="layers">
    Workflows automatically inherit environment-specific configurations and runtime variables.
  </Card>

  <Card title="Secure Secret Injection" icon="lock">
    Secrets and credentials are securely managed and injected only during workflow execution.
  </Card>

  <Card title="RBAC Enforcement" icon="user-shield">
    Workflow execution permissions follow your organization's access control policies automatically.
  </Card>
</CardGroup>

# Real-Time Workflow Execution

Automation should feel instant, observable, and reliable.

Revolte provides a live execution engine with detailed operational visibility for every workflow run.

You can monitor:
- execution stages
- runtime duration
- environment provisioning
- agent creation
- task execution
- deployment status
- cleanup operations
- workflow failures
- retry states

## Built-In Operational Transparency

Every workflow execution includes:
- complete execution history
- detailed stage-level logs
- provisioning visibility
- infrastructure events
- execution timing
- failure diagnostics
- retry monitoring

This removes the need to manually inspect external CI/CD systems or infrastructure consoles.

# Trigger Workflows Instantly

Workflows can be:
- manually triggered
- event-triggered
- schedule-triggered
- repository-triggered
- environment-triggered
- integration-triggered

<Steps>
  <Step title="Select a Workflow">
    Navigate to Automation Configurations and choose the workflow you want to execute.
  </Step>

  <Step title="Provide Runtime Parameters">
    Pass dynamic execution inputs such as deployment versions, environment identifiers, user IDs, migration ranges, or operational flags.
  </Step>

  <Step title="Execute Securely">
    Revolte provisions the execution runtime automatically and safely executes the workflow inside the target environment.
  </Step>
</Steps>

# Native Integration Ecosystem

Automation becomes significantly more powerful when connected to external systems.

Revolte workflows can integrate with:
- Jira
- Git providers
- deployment pipelines
- internal APIs
- ticketing systems
- monitoring systems
- operational tooling

For example:
- automatically deploy when a Jira ticket moves to QA
- trigger migrations when a PR merges
- run validation workflows during release approval
- execute recovery scripts during incidents
